reason: Three hundred quid of my money going to a brand new seller with no reviews, paid by bank transfer, for wheels I can't see yet? On Marketplace I'd just keep scrolling and compare with other sellers I can message and see feedback on.
objection: Refurbished paint could peel or the wheel could crack again, and with no reviews and a 7-day return only if they come back unmarked, I'd be stuck if the fit or finish is wrong once I've had a tyre fitter put them on.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real photos of the actual set, reviews or local people who've bought from them, a written fit guarantee, and a warranty on the finish for at least 6 months, ideally with a way to pay that protects me.
